title: Primary Exhilarate
summary: Primary Exhilarate is a Primary Arcane that on inflicting a weapon  Impact status effect adds Energy regeneration over time for 10 seconds and stacks up to 3 times.
extract:
Primary Exhilarate is a Primary Arcane that on inflicting a weapon  Impact status effect adds Energy regeneration over time for 10 seconds and stacks up to 3 times.

Effect

Acquisition
May appear as a Steel Path Circuit Tier 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, or +11 reward on a weekly rotational basis.
May be sold by Acrithis for 10  Pathos Clamps on a daily rotational basis, requiring Drifter Intrinsics Opportunity Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
May drop from undercroft portals in the Duviri experience while on steel path

Notes
When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
Casting an ability will stop the energy generation for 1 second.
Arcane only triggers on  Impact status procs inflicted via primary weapons.

Tips
Useful on primary weapons that can consistently proc  Impact on direct hit. For example directly hitting an enemy with  Bubonico alt-fire can trigger  Impact procs or using high  Impact rifles with low fire-rate to effectively use  Internal Bleeding like the  Kuva Chakkhurr.

Bugs
 Dex Pixia and  Diwata can trigger this arcane.
